owner_report_after_photos: The USB hub appeared to receive no power and the console did not respond. The owner later reported that the phone was accessible by ADB.
limits: The photos establish that WinPE displayed a command window on the OPPO. They do not establish that startup initialization completed, the console accepted input, or a command ran. The reason the console remained blank and the cause of the USB symptom were not established.

photos.visual_review: Wide view of the physical OPPO with a Windows command window over the blue WinPE background. The title appears to end in cmd.exe - startnet.cmd. The console area is blank and the yellow Orange State notice remains visible.
Close view of the physical command window. The title shows X:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe and the console area is blank. The yellow Orange State notice remains visible.
